seconds.description: Timed session duration. Cannot be combined with count.

count.description: Count session. Without seconds or count, use 60 seconds. For fingers, quotes, and two-key, use 25 to select the complete passage.

hints.description: Enable chord hints. Hidden audio text still requires explicit reveal.

pool.description: Common vocabulary or the eligible dictionary.

concepts.description: none, single, starter, all, or comma-separated concept IDs. Requires restricted=true for drills and keyboardSet=selected for chords. Chord exercises omit briefs.

focus.description: Require this concept in a qualifying outline. Requires restricted=true for drills. Does not unlock missing concepts.

minLength.description: Minimum word length; must not exceed maxLength.

inputMode.description: Translated text or raw outline input.

repeatOnError.description: Enable recovery repetitions after a mistake.

errorRepetitions.description: Recovery passes; requires repeatOnError=true. Recovery uses the larger of this and repetitions.

audio.description: Enable self-paced audio. Voice selection stays personal.
